issue_context.title: [Feature] Component testing and page.goto
issue_context.body:
**Context:**
- Playwright Version: 1.24.0
- Operating System: All
- Node.js version:  v17.3.0
- Browser: Chromium
- Extra: Vue component testing

<!-- CLI to auto-capture this info -->
<!-- npx envinfo --preset playwright --markdown -->

I've been playing with the Vue component testing feature and it seems like the `page.goto()` is not working properly.

For example 
[i have a failing test that should be passing](https://github.com/sand4rt/TVmaze/blob/master/src/Features/NotFound/NotFoundPage.test.ts).

It should navigate to the 404 page because i have a catch all specified [`/:pathMatch(.*)*`](https://router.vuejs.org/guide/essentials/dynamic-matching.html#catch-all-404-not-found-route) inside Vue router [see the code here](https://github.com/sand4rt/TVmaze/blob/master/src/Router/Index.ts#L52).

The Vue router plugin is registered [here](https://github.com/sand4rt/TVmaze/blob/master/playwright/index.ts).

[Here](https://github.com/sand4rt/TVmaze/blob/master/src/Features/Browse/BrowsePage.test.ts#L61) you can see another example that also uses the `page.goto` function that i can't get to work.
comments:
Thanks for explaining! Yes, makes sense. Yeah i believe it's either history mode or hash mode. 

The first use case/test is works!

Navigating before mount doesn't work yet. I need to debug it a little further.

Don't you think that the API for navigating in SPA's is a bit too verbose? I think the `config.use.baseURL` setting is not respected when using `page.evaluate(() => window.history.....)` as well right?

Why not something like?:

```typescript
page.goto('/route-not-exsist', { mode: 'history' })
```

> Don't you think that the API for navigating in SPA's is a bit too verbose? I think the config.use.baseURL setting is not respected when using page.evaluate(() => window.history.....) as well right?

Well, the document's [baseURL](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/base) will be used, which is different from our baseURL.

> Why not something like page.goto('/route-not-exsist', { mode: 'history' })?

No real reason to not add it, we can have that sugar. We can convert this issue into the request for this feature.

I'm not surprised - the way routers work is their implementation detail. The contract is that they would give you a way to create a link and that link would work. So the test for it would suggest that you are clicking the link instead.

I don't think a link is the only contract. Users are able to type the url in the browsers address bar as well _(aka `page.goto`)_. imo we should be able to mimic the user's behaviour even if this reloads the JS state.
